meta.title: Her Footprint vs. What We Want
meta.pin_note: Pin positions are georeferenced from a screenshot of her Google My Map at metro zoom. Individual pins are accurate to roughly a mile; overlapping markers mean the count is ±3.
meta.hull_note: The dashed boundary is the convex hull of her observed pins — it is where she HAS screens, NOT a confirmed territory line. Her actual grant could be larger, smaller, or a different shape entirely. Nobody has shown us the boundary.

targets.name: Germantown
targets.note: Highest household income in Tennessee. She has ~3 pins in this area.

targets.name: Collierville
targets.note: 11 miles from Olive Branch. No pins observed.

targets.name: Olive Branch
targets.note: Mississippi's #1 boomtown. ~3 pins — a toehold, not a network.

targets.name: Hernando
targets.note: Fastest-growing in DeSoto, +10.96%. ~3-4 pins near I-55.

targets.name: Southaven
targets.note: Her stronghold — ~12-14 pins with Horn Lake. Richest venue inventory in the county.

targets.name: Arlington
targets.note: Third-highest income in the metro. Family-formation suburb.

targets.name: Lakeland
targets.note: ~1-2 pins observed on the eastern edge of her Bartlett cluster.

targets.name: Bartlett
targets.note: Her densest Tennessee cluster — ~7-9 pins across Bartlett/Lakeland.

excluded.name: Memphis core
excluded.why: 606,132 people, but $51,736 median household income and the most contested media market in the region. Density is not spending power.

excluded.name: West Memphis
excluded.why: Down 10.45% since 2010, still falling. 29% poverty rate.

excluded.name: Millington
excluded.why: Small, north of the arc, no growth story.

excluded.name: Horn Lake
excluded.why: Wealthy enough but flat at -0.01%/yr. Fill-in once a rep is already driving the county — not a reason to ask.
